verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents gaming-performance features: DLSS Multi Frame Generation generating up to five frames per rendered frame, path tracing with fourth-gen RT Cores, and Reflex low latency. Tom's Hardware independently found the RTX 5090 the fastest GPU it had tested 'most of the time.' Reviewers also caution that MFG-inflated frame rates add latency and do not equal native high-refresh responsiveness. Missing for 10: specific independent 4K game benchmark figures (FPS at 4K across titles), explicit evidence of native high-refresh 4K frame rates without frame generation, and a direct comparison of vendor FPS claims against measured results.
